We will start from the parent solution (n_points=47) and explore nearby resolutions while systematically mutating the parent structure. The goal is to find a configuration with lower C5 than the current record by simultaneously respecting the integral constraint and minimizing the maximum overlap.

This approach combines structural adaptation and constraint-preserving mutations to better approximate the continuous optimum.

The mutation maintains step behavior while softly enforcing the integral constraint.
